def test_words_in_sentence():
    # Only words with prime-length are kept
    assert words_in_sentence("This is a test") == "is"
    assert words_in_sentence("lets go for swimming") == "go for"
    assert words_in_sentence("there is no place available here") == "there is no place"
    assert words_in_sentence("Hi I am Hulk") == "Hi am"

    # All words have prime lengths (3, 3, 5)
    assert words_in_sentence("one two three") == "one two three"

    # No words have prime lengths (4, 4)
    assert words_in_sentence("like home") == ""

    # Single-character words are excluded (1 is not prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("a") == ""
    assert words_in_sentence("I am") == "am"

    # Empty sentence
    assert words_in_sentence("") == ""

    # Length-2 words are always included
    assert words_in_sentence("go") == "go"

    # Mixed prime (7) and non-prime (6) lengths
    assert words_in_sentence("example simply") == "example"

    # Both words prime length (5, 5)
    assert words_in_sentence("seven brown") == "seven brown"
